Semantic events are standardized event names and properties that Segment recognizes for specific industry verticals and applications. This semantic meaning allows Segment to specially recognize and transform key events before routing them to downstream destinations.

Semantic specs are defined for:
- Mobile
- A/B Testing
- Ecommerce
- Email
- Live Chat
- Video

Each spec defines the recognized event names and required/optional properties for that domain. Semantic events build on the [Track](/docs/segment/connections/spec/track) call, which describes arbitrary user-triggered events. Refer to the domain-specific spec when instrumenting or validating events.
